sentences.fa: چقدر طول مي کشه که شام رو حاضر کني؟ خيلي گرسنه ام.
sentences.en: How long does it take you to make the dinner ready, I am very hungry.
It doesn't take so long.
I am calling you.

sentences.fa: چيزي شده؟ کاسه اي زير نيم کاسه هست.
sentences.en: Is anything wrong? I smell a rat.
You are off color, what's wrong with you?
I have got a vomit, have you got any tablets?
Why don't you take a pain killer?

sentences.fa: نياز به مسکن نداري، مي برمت دکتر.
sentences.en: You don't need a pain killer; I am taking you to a doctor.
Who loves you?
Who likes you?
Who do you like?

sentences.fa: کي به اين پول نياز داره؟
sentences.en: Who needs this money?
Who does your mother need?
I don't need anything.

sentences.fa: براي چي برادرت رو اينجا دعوت نمي کني؟
sentences.en: Why don't you invite your brother here?

sentences.fa: مادرت چي شده؟ چرا نشسته اينجا هي داره غر مي زنه؟
sentences.en: What's wrong with your mother? Why is she sitting here, nagging over and over?

sentences.fa: برادرت دکتري رو اينجا مي شناسه؟ مي خوام مادرم رو ببرم دکتر، حالش خوب نيست.
sentences.en: Does your brother know any doctors here? I am gonna take my mother to a doctor, she is under the weather.
She is down.
I have got a party, are you coming tonight?

sentences.fa: کسي رو نمي شناسم، کجا بيام؟
sentences.en: I don't know anyone, where shall I come?

sentences.fa: خیلی طول مي کشه يه ليوان آب برام بياري؟
sentences.en: Does it take so long to bring me a glass of water?
It takes 1 hour.
How long does it take?

sentences.fa: نگران نباش، زياد طول نمي کشه.
sentences.en: Don't worry, it doesn't take so long.

sentences.fa: بيشتر با ماشينت مي آيي اداره يا با مترو؟
sentences.en: Do you often come to the office in your car or by metro?
He often takes a taxi.

sentences.fa: پدرم بيشتر پياده مي آد اينجا.
sentences.en: My father often comes here on foot.

sentences.fa: براي چي اين موضوع را در جلسه مطرح نمي کني؟
sentences.en: Why don't you bring up this subject at the meeting?

sentences.fa: شروع کنيم؟ شروع کنيم. سؤالي داري؟ سؤالي ندارم. شروع کنيم.
sentences.en: Shall we start? Let's start, have you got any question? I haven't got question, let's start.
